constraints.explain: The legacy v2 feeds route returns stale data and is not the canonical v3 search path.
The v2 feed list omits the snapshot pointer and uses feedId, so it cannot yield the snapshot path.
The user explicitly does not want the draft alert record's view; the answer must come from the digest.
The deprecated v2 list omits the snapshot pointer and returns camelCase feedId.
The user explicitly wanted the draft created but NOT published.
The deprecated v2 feed list drops the snapshot pointer and must not be relied upon.
The fix is attaching the Authorization bearer to the snapshots/latest call, which is what resolves the 401.
The user explicitly distrusts the draft alert record's status field; the answer must come from the digest, not the alert record GET.
The user's token is fine; the fix is the malformed header, so no new token should be minted.
The legacy v2 feeds route is a decoy and not the live digest source.
The v2 feed list omits the snapshot pointer and must not be used as the source.
The user explicitly said not to go through the v2 feed list; it carries none of this data.
The v2 list omits the snapshot flag and never lists Harbor Ferry; falling back to it is disallowed.
